senses.en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity
the physical features and arrangement of a particular area

ex.en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
ex.zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。

ex.en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。

tip: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

senses.en: Past events, or the study of them.
A record of someone's or something's past experiences or conditions.

ex.en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
ex.zh: 导游讲述了这座古堡的历史。

ex.en: Studying history helps citizens understand how past decisions continue to shape modern societies and institutions.
ex.zh: 学习历史有助于公民理解过去的决策如何持续塑造现代社会及其制度。

tip: historical指与历史有关；historic指有历史意义。

senses.en: used to ask about the reason for something
introduces the reason for a situation or action

ex.en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
ex.zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？

ex.en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

tip: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

senses.en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.

ex.en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
ex.zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。

ex.en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
ex.zh: 许多通勤者选择公共交通，因为它比独自开车更省钱，排放也更少。

col: because of the weather｜由于天气原因
tip: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期一去市场买新鲜水果。

ex.en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
ex.zh: 许多员工觉得星期一早上压力很大，因为他们必须处理周末积压的任务。

col: from Monday to Friday｜从星期一到星期五
tip: 星期首字母大写；用on Monday，但next Monday前不加on。

senses.en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday

ex.en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期五在家一起做晚饭。

ex.en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 允许员工星期五居家办公，可能减轻通勤压力并提高工作满意度。

tip: 首字母大写；on Friday，但 next Friday 前不加 on。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

tip: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: Certainly; without any doubt.

ex.en: I will come for sure.
ex.zh: 我一定会来。

ex.en: He knows the answer for sure.
ex.zh: 他确切知道答案。

senses.en: Costing no money.
Able to act or move without being controlled or restricted.
To release someone or something from control or confinement.

ex.en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。

ex.en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
ex.zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。

tip: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

senses.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

ex.en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期二晚上一起吃饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Tuesday to help newcomers settle into the area.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周二提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者适应当地生活。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；every Tuesday前不用on。

senses.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
ex.zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

tip: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

senses.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

senses.en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

ex.en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
ex.zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。

ex.en: Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
ex.zh: 早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。

col: from nine a.m.｜从上午九点起
until eleven a.m.｜直到上午十一点
tip: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。

senses.en: after noon and before midnight, used when stating a time

ex.en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
ex.zh: 游泳池今天晚上八点关门。

ex.en: Keeping public libraries open until nine p.m. would allow more working adults to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 让公共图书馆开放至晚上九点，可以使更多在职成年人获取教育资源。

col: until ten p.m.｜直到晚上十点
tip: 放在时间后；12 p.m.是中午，12 a.m.是午夜。

senses.en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose

ex.en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
ex.zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。

ex.en: Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.
ex.zh: 对于无法使用设备完善的图书馆的学习者来说，可靠的网络资源可能很有帮助。

tip: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。

senses.en: showing where someone or something starts or originates
showing what causes something
showing separation, difference, or distance

ex.en: This postcard came from my cousin in the mountains.
ex.zh: 这张明信片是住在山区的表亲寄来的。

ex.en: Students from rural communities may face additional barriers when applying to universities in major cities.
ex.zh: 来自农村社区的学生申请大城市的大学时，可能面临额外障碍。

col: from start to finish｜从头到尾
tip: from表示起点，常与表示终点的to搭配。

senses.en: Showing the start and end of a time or place range.

ex.en: The party is from seven to nine.
ex.zh: 派对从七点到九点。

ex.en: We have classes from Monday to Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周一到周五有课。

senses.en: A title for a married woman, before her family name.
senses.zh: 夫人；太太（称呼已婚女性，后接姓氏）

ex.en: Mrs. Brown is Tom's mother.
ex.zh: 布朗夫人是汤姆的妈妈。

ex.en: Good morning, Mrs. Green!
ex.zh: 早上好，格林夫人！

tip: Mrs. 只用于已婚女性；未婚用 Miss，未知婚否用 Ms.。

senses.en: to complete something or reach its end
the final part or end of something
the appearance or texture of a completed surface

ex.en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
ex.zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。

ex.en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
ex.zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。

tip: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

senses.en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject.
Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.

ex.en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。

ex.en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
ex.zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。

tip: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

senses.en: a period of sixty minutes
the times when someone works or a service operates

ex.en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
ex.zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。

ex.en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。

tip: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。
